mode: A (per-repo records) — exploratory format: collector = census.sh, raw = results*.tsv + pool.json + raw/; this stats.json normalizes the SUMMARY.md findings into the catalog shape
question: How do top-starred OSS harnesses structure their repo skeleton, and does it diverge from our compiled standard (breadth concern)?
method: gh search repos across harness topics → 1,118 unique → noise-filtered → top 200 by stars; per-repo gh meta + recursive git tree → file-presence booleans; forks dropped. Star-farmed ecosystem → reported as full-200 (noisy) + hand-verified canonical n=36 (trustworthy signal).

software_floor_pct.note: canon ALL is the trustworthy signal; full200 ALL shown for the long tail

key_findings: Application harnesses ship exactly our L0 floor (README/LICENSE/gitignore/CI/tests/manifest ~100% canonical) — no conflict with the standard.
Committed lockfile only ~56% → gingoa's commit-it call is a deliberate [lit] choice above the census norm.

Mature harnesses converge on an ADDITIVE capability layer: skills/commands/hooks/prompts/mcp/plugin+marketplace/schema/examples/agent-md/templates — the gap = an 8th 'AI-harness' archetype (ADR-0009).
Bimodal: application harness (full floor + capability layer) vs content harness (capability layer, manifest/lockfile 0%). gingoa = application harness that also ships content.
